# Scientific and technical topics

This page brings together areas explored through research, engineering work, and structured learning. It distinguishes topics applied in projects from topics currently being studied.

## Scientific modelling and applied mathematics

- Atmospheric dispersion and environmental modelling
- Applied mathematics, numerical simulation, and scientific computing
- Fluid mechanics and environmental processes, where supported by confirmed research records

## Software engineering

- Python software design, typing, testing, and separation of concerns
- Maintainability, data validation, automation, and reproducible workflows
- Backend engineering and API design

## Data science and machine learning

- Classification metrics and aggregation of evaluation results
- Model validation, generalisation, data leakage, and calibration
- Threshold selection, error analysis, and experimental reproducibility

## LLMs and knowledge systems

- Evaluation of language-model outputs and hallucination-detection systems
- Small language models and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, including LoRA/QLoRA
- Source ingestion, structured knowledge generation, provenance, and validation

This is a map of topics worked on or being studied, not a claim of expert-level mastery in every area. Project evidence and learning progress will be added as they become available.
